_que_es: Tienda, Game Passes del núcleo y del armador (2026-11-02). python tools/storeart.py base skills/_shared/tienda/recetas/pases.json --out base.png; python tools/imagegen.py generate skills/_shared/tienda/recetas/pases.json --ref base.png --quality high --n 1 --out <carpeta>; python tools/storeart.py finish skills/_shared/tienda/recetas/pases.json --sheet <hoja>.png --out assets/ui/store-art.

ia.prompt: Keep the same 9 tiles, in this order: 1) money2x: a fat golden money bag bursting with green dollar bills and gold coins on a tile of the same color as the draft, 2) luck2x: a shiny green four-leaf clover with golden sparkles on a tile of the same color as the draft, 3) speed2x: a blue sneaker with a white lightning bolt and speed lines on a tile of the same color as the draft, 4) vip: a golden royal crown with red and blue jewels on a tile of the same color as the draft, 5) autocollect: a big red horseshoe magnet pulling gold coins toward it on a tile of the same color as the draft, 6) extraslots: a cozy house with a red roof and a green plus badge on a tile of the same color as the draft, 7) sellanywhere: a flying stack of green cash with little white wings on a tile of the same color as the draft, 8) autoclicker: a yellow pointing hand tapping, with motion lines and a small silver gear on a tile of the same color as the draft, 9) giftpass: a red gift box with a golden ribbon and sparkles on a tile of the same color as the draft.
